versions.summary: Allows letters in grids as page annotations and adds printable layout notes.

items: Added a Notes field to layouts and regulars (templates do not save notes) as a multi-line Text area between the press grid and the button bar, persisted to layouts/regulars JSON and preserved through touch/cleanup and press/format conversions.

Notes print on the printed layout between the layout grid and the legend using the same font and size as the Color pages list, positioned about 2 inches above the legend; the legend and color pages list remain anchored.
Added dirty tracking for notes so unsaved note edits prompt to save on close.
Grid cells now accept letters and alphanumeric values such as C1 and C2; validation allows isalnum values and only flags non-alphanumeric symbols.

For imposition name, page counts, template saving/matching, occupancy and dinky detection, the letter portion is stripped and only the numeric part is used so C1 is interpreted as 1 and C2 as 2; pure letters with no digits are treated as empty.
Updated safe_int to extract digits via regex so all page-number calculations consistently ignore letter prefixes/suffixes.

versions.summary: Scopes single-instance enforcement to each Windows user instead of the entire computer.

items: Fixed Press Layouts blocking a second signed-in Windows user when another user on the same computer already had the application open.
Changed the single-instance mutex, activation port, and activation token to use a stable per-user key.
Press Layouts still prevents the same Windows user from opening a second instance, while allowing different Windows users on the same workstation to run one instance each.
Updated the duplicate-instance warning to clarify that the one-instance limit applies per Windows user account.

versions.summary: Adds administrator visibility and control for active Press Layouts user sessions.

items: Added PostgreSQL-backed logged-in user session tracking with username, workstation, process ID, version, database mode, login time, and last heartbeat.
Made the main launcher (ADMIN) flag clickable so administrators can view active Press Layouts sessions.
Added an administrator Force Logout action that requests the selected remote Press Layouts session to close and records which administrator requested it.
Active sessions now send a heartbeat every 15 seconds and stale session rows are removed after 90 seconds.
A forced-logout request shows the affected user who requested the logout and then closes their running Press Layouts application.

versions.summary: Major release. Adds a changelog feature summary, shows the latest version by default, and adds a Full History view.

items: The changelog window now opens to a "What's New in Press Layouts 1.5.0" summary of features added since 1.4.0, followed by the latest release entry.
Added a Full History button that expands the changelog window to the complete version history.

versions.summary: Validates dropped planning manifests before opening them externally.

items: Plan-button drops with no recognizable sections now fail with 'Invalid file/message for planning wizard' without opening the source item or planning wizard.

versions.summary: Opens dropped planning manifests in their associated application.

items: Dropping a PDF or email message on the Plan button now opens the source item in its registered Windows application while also loading it into the planning wizard.

versions.summary: Adds a double-truck explanation to printed-layout legends.

items: Added a light-blue blue-box symbol and '= double truck' label beside the color-page legend at the bottom of printed layouts.

versions.summary: Groups layout-editor color and double-truck controls.

items: Grouped Color Select, All Color, and All B/W controls together and grouped DT Select, Set DT, and Clear DT controls together in the layout editor.

versions.summary: Updates planning-wizard template hover previews to show generated layouts.

items: Planning-wizard template hover previews now use the selected run's sections, actual pages, color-page selections, and double trucks instead of displaying the untouched template.

versions.summary: Corrects color handling for email-manifest double trucks.

items: Fixed center-spread double trucks loaded from email manifests so every parsed DT group is marked color in the planning wizard, while Butt in Gutter metadata remains ignored.

versions.summary: Loads email-manifest double trucks as color groups in the planning wizard.

items: Fixed manifest-derived double trucks defaulting to B/W on the planning wizard color-page screen; parsed double trucks are now marked color automatically.

versions.summary: Parses center-spread gutter-bleed double trucks from email manifests.

items: Added parsing of Center Spread Gutter Bleed metadata from Outlook messages, including continuation lines and multiple section/page pairs.
Resolved parsed section aliases through the section translation table so multiple email DTs are loaded into the corresponding planning-wizard sections.

versions.summary: Improves double-truck rendering across the editor, previews, and printed layouts.

items: Fixed the Broadsheet right-column divider not being removed for vertical double trucks.
Removed the internal double-truck grid line in previews and printed layouts and added a very light blue spread background while preserving readable page numbers.

versions.summary: Improves double-truck selection visibility in the layout editor.

items: Highlighted both page cells while selecting a double truck and removed the internal press-grid divider once the double truck is set.

versions.summary: Adds double-truck support to layouts, regulars, printing, previews, and planning validation.

items: Added layout-editor double-truck selection with blue spread boxes in the editor, printed layouts, and previews.
Added physical-position validation for Broadsheet, Tab, and 8-up double trucks, including planning-wizard template and dinky compatibility checks.
Preserved double trucks in layouts and regulars while preventing them from being created or saved in templates.

versions.summary: Improves launcher responsiveness and reduces unnecessary database and configuration-file work.

items: Cached product and section translation tables in memory, with invalidation after edits and database-mode changes.
Cached window-state JSON in memory and reread it only when the file changes, while preserving existing state merge behavior.
Added a process-wide PostgreSQL connection pool for psycopg2 and safely returns or discards connections after each operation.
Reduced launcher refresh polling from 5 seconds to 15 seconds and template/regular cache polling from 1.5 seconds to 5 seconds; local refresh triggers remain immediate.

versions.summary: Fixes the planning wizard keeping stale color-page state when a new manifest is dropped after another is loaded, and treats 'Spot' manifest markers as color pages.

items: Fixed the planning wizard not fully resetting when a second manifest or email is dropped after an initial one was loaded, which could leave stale color-page and double-truck state from the previous manifest applied to the new one.
Added 'Spot' as a color-page marker in PDF manifest parsing, alongside the existing 'Full' marker, so pages marked Spot in a manifest are colored when loaded into the planning wizard.

versions.summary: Fixes dragging emails from Outlook onto the Plan button and makes .msg manifest parsing read the full message body.

items: Fixed Outlook message drag-and-drop so dragging an email directly from Outlook onto the Plan button or planning wizard loads its manifest; when tkdnd cannot extract the email contents from the drop (FileGroupDescriptorW with an empty payload), the app retrieves the selected email from Outlook via COM and parses it.
Fixed .msg manifest parsing truncation by reading the full message body through Outlook COM first, with a file-based CFB fallback, so long split and main manifest bodies parse completely.
Fixed drop payload handling so manifest drops are no longer silently ignored when the delivered path is unrecognized, and an explanatory dialog appears for non-manifest drops.
Fixed the planning wizard's template picker page so the press run boxes scroll when there are many press runs, instead of overflowing the dialog.
Added parsing of manifest emails saved as .eml files, extracting the plain-text tab-separated body the same way as .msg messages.
Added content-based manifest detection that checks the file's magic bytes in addition to the file extension, so tkdnd temp files load even when their names do not end in .msg, .eml, or .pdf.

versions.summary: Adds an admin-only product name translation table to the planning wizard for mapping manifest PDF product names.

items: Added a Translation Table button on the first page of the planning wizard, visible only to admin users, that opens a dialog for managing incoming-to-output product name mappings.
Added product name translation that automatically applies the translation table when a manifest PDF is loaded into the planning wizard.
Added a persistent JSON-based translation table stored at L:\PressLayouts\product_translations.json.

versions.summary: Fixes multi-section manifest PDF parsing and Outlook drag-and-drop of email attachments.

items: Fixed the manifest PDF parser to handle 3+ section columns by clustering page-number digit X values into N columns instead of assuming only 2, so color pages in sections after the first two (e.g. Greenville sections B and C) are detected correctly.
Fixed Outlook email-attachment drag-and-drop by injecting missing Tcl dictionary entries for FileGroupDescriptorW and FileGroupDescriptor into tkdnd's platform-to-type mapping at runtime.
Replaced ctypes WM_DROPFILES window-subclassing drag-and-drop with tkinterdnd2 for reliable cross-application drag support.

Rewrote the Broadsheet manifest color-page parser to use position-aware text extraction, matching Full markers to page numbers by Y-coordinate per column instead of assuming color pages are the first N consecutive pages.

versions.summary: Adds a Go to Tomorrow button to the main launcher that expands tomorrow's issue date group and focuses the first layout.

items: Added a Go to Tomorrow button at the top right of the main launcher that collapses all issue date groups, expands tomorrow's issue date, and selects/focuses the first layout in that group.

versions.summary: Removes orphaned functions, dead code, and redundant imports from the source file.

items: Removed 17 orphaned functions that were never called anywhere in the codebase, including a 117-line dead duplicate screenshot function.
Removed 10 redundant import statements from the assembled module boundaries that duplicated already-available top-level imports.
Removed one redundant function-level import of the glob module.

versions.summary: Auto-generates press run names from sections/page ranges, appends run name to layout publication name, fixes product name capitalization and arrow key behavior in entries.

items: Changed the planning wizard press runs screen to auto-generate run names from the assigned section letters and page ranges, omitting page numbers when all pages are included.
Run name uses the parent section name when all subsections of a split section are assigned to the same run.
Changed planning wizard to append the auto-generated run name to the layout publication (product) field instead of only the filename.
Changed planning wizard to auto-set the starter sheet format (NYT/USAT) based on the publication name without prompting the user.
Changed press runs screen to show page ranges as read-only labels derived from section definitions rather than editable entry fields.
Fixed the layout editor product name field to capitalize as you type instead of only on focus out (the dirty-marking KeyRelease binding was overwriting the normalization handler).
Fixed arrow key handlers so text entry widgets (like the product name) preserve default cursor-movement behavior instead of switching fields, while grid cells retain their arrow-key navigation.

versions.summary: Fixes preview panel auto-refresh for database-stored layouts.

items: Fixed preview panel auto-refresh not detecting saves for database-stored layouts by using the record's updated_at timestamp as the change signature instead of attempting to stat a non-existent file on disk.

versions.summary: Refreshes the preview panel automatically when a layout is saved by any user.

items: Changed all preview panels to automatically refresh when the underlying preview image file changes on disk, so another user's save is reflected without manual reselection.
Added file-signature tracking to each preview panel so stale preview images are detected and reloaded on the next auto-refresh or cache-watcher cycle.

versions.summary: Adds a DB Maintenance action to refresh stale record-open locks.

items: Added a Refresh Record Locks button to DB Maintenance for administrators to clear stale database edit locks when a record is reported open by a user who no longer has it open.
Added a lock-refresh confirmation and detailed maintenance log showing which locks were removed.
Changed active editor lock heartbeats so if a maintenance refresh clears the lock table, any truly open editor window re-registers its own lock automatically on its next heartbeat.

versions.summary: Fixes Template Editor treeview resizing when the preview split is dragged.

items: Fixed the Template Editor layout so the template treeview row receives the vertical resize weight instead of the button row.
Changed the Template Editor preview split behavior so dragging the sash grows and shrinks the treeview like the main launcher, New Layout window, and Regular Editor.

versions.summary: Fixes template Save As so it creates a renamed copy and leaves the original template intact.

items: Fixed Template Editor Save As so the saved copy always updates the template name to the newly entered record name instead of keeping the source template name.
Changed Save As copy handling to strip database identity metadata before writing the new record, ensuring the new template is saved as a separate copy while the original template remains intact.
Changed database edit-lock switching after Save As so the editor releases the old record lock and continues tracking the newly saved copy.

versions.summary: Moves the Plan entry point into the New Layout window.

items: Moved the Plan button from the main launcher to the New Layout window.
Placed the Plan button before the From Regular / Standard Mode toggle in the New Layout window.
Changed the Plan button so it closes the New Layout window before opening the Layout Planning wizard.
The Plan button is available to all users and is not restricted to admin users.

versions.summary: Normalizes template page numbers when saving templates from layouts.

items: Changed Save as Template so each template section is saved with contiguous page numbers starting at 1, independent of the original layout page numbers.
Layouts with non-1 starts, such as pages 3-16, now save into templates as pages 1-14.
Split or non-contiguous layouts, such as pages 1-12 and 29-40, now save into templates as pages 1-24 for that section.
Updated template section page counts to match the number of unique pages saved into each template section.

versions.summary: Fixes Plan-generated impositions by clearing empty press-unit section assignments.

items: Fixed Layout Planning wizard generated layouts assigning section letters to template press units that contained no pages.
Changed generated layout page remapping so a press unit only receives the planned section name when at least one page is assigned to that unit.
Cleared section assignments from empty generated units so the imposition name matches the same layout created manually.

versions.summary: Improves Plan template matching for split sections with non-contiguous page ranges.

items: Changed final Plan template color matching to compare planned split pages by relative template position instead of requiring the actual page number to exist in the template.
Changed generated Plan layouts so templates with relative pages such as 1-24 are remapped to the actual split pages, such as 1-12 and 29-40, when the layout is generated.
Kept color-position matching strict by requiring the corresponding relative template positions for planned color pages to land on color-capable press units.

versions.summary: Refines Cleanup Layouts tree defaults and delete progress feedback.

items: Changed Cleanup Layouts so issue-date groups are collapsed by default when the dialog opens.
Added a determinate progress bar and status text while Cleanup Layouts removes selected layout files.
Changed the cleanup delete loop to update progress for each removed layout and show the current file being removed.

versions.summary: Adds the Layout Planning wizard and improves previews and cleanup selection.

items: Added the Layout Planning wizard for building planned sections, splitting sections into legal signatures, selecting color pages, assigning sections/subsections to press runs, choosing matching templates, and generating/opening finished layouts.
Added final Plan wizard template previews that appear while hovering over the open template dropdown list or the selected template picker.
Changed launcher/template/regular preview panes so previews stay visible when their window loses focus and only change when a different item is selected or the window is closed.
Changed Cleanup Layouts to use an issue-date grouped tree with no default selections.
Changed Cleanup Layouts so selecting an issue-date group selects or clears all layouts under that issue date while still allowing individual layout selection.

versions.summary: Adds Plan template hover previews and opens generated layouts directly.

items: Added a hover preview popup to the final Plan template selection screen so hovering over a template picker shows a preview of the currently selected template.
Changed Plan Finish so it no longer shows the created-layout confirmation dialog.
Changed Plan Finish to generate the layout JSON files and immediately open each generated layout as a new layout window.
Kept error dialogs only for failure cases where a generated layout cannot be opened.

versions.summary: Improves Plan final screen section labels and generated color-cell mapping.

items: Changed the Plan final screen Sections labels to separate section names from page counts, such as B1 - 6p, B2 - 6p, so subsection names do not run into the page count.
Fixed generated Plan layouts not circling planned color pages by calculating color_cells from the selected template before overwriting template section names with planned section names.
Kept selected template matching behavior unchanged while ensuring the final generated layout receives the planned color cells for the chosen template.

versions.summary: Fixes Plan final-screen color-state lookup error.

items: Fixed the Plan final template-selection screen going blank with a NameError by moving the color-page state lookup helper into the shared Plan wizard scope.
Kept the page-two local color drawing behavior intact while allowing later wizard screens to evaluate selected color pages for template matching and generated layout color_cells.

versions.summary: Makes Plan template matching and generated layouts honor planned color pages.

items: Fixed Plan template suggestions so matching templates must have every planned color page available on a color-capable unit/cell for that press run.
Fixed generated Plan layouts so selected color pages are written into the layout color_cells list when a matching template is used.
Changed Plan color matching to account for split subsections, double-truck color groups, template section names, and press-specific K-only units.
Kept the (NEW) fallback when no template matches the press, format, page counts, and planned color positions.

versions.summary: Adds Plan press-run and template-selection screens.

items: Added a Next button to the Plan color-page screen that opens a new Press Runs screen.
Added a Press Runs screen that defaults to one Press 1 run, allows adding/deleting runs, picking Press 1 or Press 2, and assigning sections or split subsections to one or more runs.
Added a final Template screen that lists each press run, defaults to the first matching template when available, and shows (NEW) when no template matches.

Added Finish behavior that creates one layout JSON for each press run, cloning the selected template when one is chosen and stamping the wizard issue date, publication, press, format, section names, and page counts.

versions.summary: Fixes Plan validation flicker and Split dialog freeze.

items: Fixed rapid Plan validation/status flicker after choosing an Issue Date by stopping validation from rewriting Issue Date and Publication variables while validation is running.
Fixed validation event storms by debouncing first-screen validation updates and preventing recursive validation calls.
Fixed the Split button freeze caused by the validation loop monopolizing the Tk event loop before the signature-count dialog could open.
Changed the Plan status bar setter so it only updates the Tk variable when the displayed validation text actually changes.

versions.summary: Adds Plan date picker, live Next validation, and parented color-page subsections.

items: Changed the Plan first-screen Issue Date field so clicking it opens the same calendar date picker used by the layout editor.
Changed the Plan Next button so it stays disabled while required fields or section values are invalid, including on initial window creation.
Added required validation for Issue Date and Publication before the Plan wizard can advance to color-page selection.
Changed first-screen validation to show a non-modal red status bar immediately for invalid starting values such as the default empty or zero A-section page count.
Changed the Plan color-page screen so split subsections display as children under their parent section and inherit the parent section color.

versions.summary: Adds live split recalculation and calculated page-range labels in Plan.

items: Changed the Plan first-page #Start with column to a calculated Pages label column that displays page ranges such as 1-12, 1-6 / 7-12, or 1-12, 37-48 for wrapped Tab signatures.
Changed split subsections so editing one subsection page count recalculates the matching signature counts and page ranges on the fly without interrupting typing.
Added a non-modal red status bar on the Plan first page that explains illegal live split states while still allowing the user to continue typing a valid value.
Changed Plan validation so it recalculates all split parents before continuing and only blocks Next if the split state is still illegal.
Kept split page-range calculation format-aware so Broadsheet remains contiguous and Tab / 8 up signatures continue to wrap from outside pages inward.

versions.summary: Refines Plan split display, header alignment, and signature limits.

items: Changed the first Plan wizard page header row to use fixed header positions so #Pages, #Start with, Split, and Format align over their matching controls.
Changed Plan split behavior so the original section remains visible and generated signatures are inserted beneath it as connected subsections.
Changed split subsections to reuse the original section color so the parent and generated signatures visually stay grouped together.
Changed valid signature counts to 2 through 4 only, since one signature is not a split and more than four signatures are not used.
Changed validation for the next Plan step so a split parent section is kept for display but its generated legal subsections are what continue forward.

versions.summary: Adds Plan section split button and aligned first-page headers.

items: Changed the first Plan wizard page so column headers sit in the same padded grid as the section rows, keeping Section, #Pages, #Start with, Split, Format, and Delete aligned.
Changed the Plan Split control from a checkbox to a Split button that validates the section page count before opening a signature-count confirmation dialog.
Changed Split confirmation so it creates the requested subsection signatures with legal page counts for Broadsheet, Tab, and 8 up formats.
Added balanced legal split handling so uneven Broadsheet splits use valid page counts such as 6 and 4 instead of illegal 5 and 5.
Added wrapped page grouping for Tab and 8 up splits so outside signatures receive the first and last page ranges while later signatures move inward.

versions.summary: Makes Plan double-truck page selection section-specific.

items: Changed Plan wizard color-page selection so the two-page selection limit is enforced per section instead of globally across all sections.
Changed the double-truck right-click action so it only evaluates the clicked row’s section and never crosses sections.
Changed Set Double Truck (DT) so after the pair is created, selection is cleared for that section instead of leaving the new DT row selected.
Kept support for separate DT pairs in the same section and independent selections in different sections.

versions.summary: Limits Plan double trucks to exactly two pages and tightens the right-click menu.

items: Changed Plan wizard double-truck selection so only two single pages can be selected at a time; selecting a third page keeps the first selected page and replaces the second selected page.
Changed Set Double Truck (DT) so it is available only when exactly two single pages in the same section are selected.
Changed the right-click menu so Single Pages appears only when right-clicking an existing DT row, and no menu appears when the clicked row is not eligible for an action.
Kept support for multiple separate double trucks in the same section, such as 1/10 and 2/9, by setting each pair separately.

versions.summary: Adds multi-select double-truck controls to Plan color pages.

items: Added multi-select behavior on the Plan wizard color-page list so multiple page rows can be selected by clicking the row text/background.
Added a right-click menu with Set Double Truck (DT) and Single Pages actions for selected color-page rows.
Added double-truck grouping so selected pages, including non-consecutive paired pages such as 2/9 or 1/10, display as one combined DT row with one shared color/BW state.
Changed color-box clicks to continue toggling color/BW for the clicked single page or DT group, while row clicks manage selection for double-truck actions.

versions.summary: Shortens Plan color-page section and page labels.

items: Changed Plan wizard color-page section headers to omit the word Section, abbreviate Broadsheet to BS, and shorten pages to pgs.
Changed Plan wizard color-page row labels to show only the page number plus K or 4C status, instead of prefixing each row with Page.

versions.summary: Fixes initial Plan color-page scroll setup.

items: Fixed the Plan wizard color-selection page so the scrollbar and mouse-wheel scrolling initialize immediately when the page first opens, without requiring a window resize.
Added an after-idle color-page layout pass that updates the canvas/list dimensions and then binds mouse-wheel scrolling after all page rows have been rendered.

versions.summary: Fixes Plan color-page scrolling and applies section colors to planning rows.

items: Fixed the Plan wizard color-selection page so taller page lists are no longer clipped and can scroll with the scrollbar and mouse wheel.
Fixed unused vertical space on the color-selection page by clearing the previous wizard row weight and letting the color list area use all available space between the title and bottom buttons.
Changed the color-selection section grid to stretch only when content is shorter than the available viewport, while preserving natural height and scrolling when page lists are taller.
Changed the first Plan wizard page so each section row uses the same pastel color sequence as the color-selection panels.

versions.summary: Expands Plan color panels and adds pastel section backgrounds.

items: Changed the Plan wizard color-selection page so the section grid stretches to fill the available space above the bottom buttons instead of leaving unused whitespace below the page lists.
Changed the color-selection section panels to use pastel backgrounds: pink, blue, green, and purple, repeating for additional sections.
Kept each section panel arranged in the up-to-four-column layout with pages listed vertically inside each section.

versions.summary: Tightens Plan wizard input alignment and color-page space usage.

items: Changed the first Plan wizard page so section labels and inputs use the same grid columns, keeping Section, #Pages, #Start with, Split, Format, and Delete controls aligned.
Removed the instructional text from the Plan wizard color-selection page so section panels use the full available area above the bottom buttons.
Kept the color-selection section panels in the up-to-four-column layout with pages listed vertically inside each section.

versions.summary: Arranges Plan wizard color sections in up to four columns.

items: Changed the Plan wizard color page so section panels flow left-to-right in up to four columns before wrapping to the next row.
Kept the pages inside each section panel listed vertically while preserving the per-section All Color and All B/W controls.

versions.summary: Refines Plan wizard entry formatting, spacing, color controls, and scrolling.

items: Changed the Plan wizard Issue Date field to normalize to mm/dd/yyyy on Enter, focus-out, and Next, matching the layout editor date format behavior.
Changed the Plan wizard Publication and Section fields to uppercase automatically while typing.
Widened the Plan wizard window and spread the first-page section columns further apart for easier entry.
Changed the color selection page so each section displays as a vertical list of pages.
Added per-section All controls with clickable 4-color and black boxes to set all pages in that section to color or black-and-white.
Added mouse-wheel scrolling support to the Plan wizard scrollable section and color-list areas.

versions.summary: Adds the first two Plan wizard pages to the main launcher.

items: Added a Plan button between New and Open on the main launcher.
Added the first Plan wizard page with Issue Date, Publication, section name, #Pages, #Start with, Split, and per-section format controls.
Added + Add Section and x Delete controls, with new sections defaulting to the next section name such as A to B.
Added validation before continuing so Broadsheet sections require page counts in multiples of 2, Tab in multiples of 4, and 8 up in multiples of 8.
Added the second Plan wizard page that lists pages by section and lets each page toggle between black-only and 4-color, including All Color and All B/W buttons.

versions.summary: Fixes the Template Editor stale Issue Date filter reference.

items: Removed a stale Template Editor layout-filter helper that referenced issue_date_var even though the Template Editor does not define an Issue Date filter.
Cleared the Pylance reportUndefinedVariable warning for issue_date_var while leaving the main launcher Issue Date filter behavior unchanged.

versions.summary: Treats templates as matching by imposition even when page numbers differ.

items: Changed the save-layout template prompt check so an existing template with the same imposition is recognized even when the actual page numbers or section page totals are different.
Added a page-number-independent imposition signature that compares section count, unit section assignments, and occupied grid-cell positions instead of exact page values.

versions.summary: Fixes the Template Editor Pages filter startup error.

items: Fixed a Template Editor startup NameError caused by the Pages filter check referencing pages_filter before it was defined.
Added the missing Pages filter control to the Template Editor and keeps its values in sync with the displayed template rows.

versions.summary: Fixes the main launcher Pages filter startup error.

items: Fixed a startup NameError in the main launcher by placing the Pages-filter helper functions inside the main launcher scope before the initial refresh runs.

versions.summary: Adds Pages filters to launcher and New Layout lists and consolidates New Layout filters.

items: Added a Pages filter to the main launcher tree that lists the page combinations currently available from the displayed layouts.
Added a Pages filter to the New Layout window for both template and regular layout selection.
Changed the New Layout filter area so Search is on the first line and Press, Format, Sections, and Pages share the second line, matching the main launcher filter layout.

versions.summary: Shows the weekday on main launcher issue-date group rows.

items: Added the day of the week to each dated issue-date folder row in the main launcher tree and styled those issue-date rows in green for quicker scanning.

versions.summary: Adds a forced restart timer to the update-required dialog.

items: Added a 10-minute countdown to the restart required update dialog so Press Layouts automatically restarts if the dialog is not acknowledged.
Changed the restart required dialog to display the remaining automatic-restart time and cancel the timer when the user chooses Restart, Cancel, closes the dialog, or presses Escape.

versions.summary: Makes the main launcher Live/Test database label clickable and remembers the selected database mode between launches.

items: Added click-to-toggle behavior to the main launcher Live/Test database label so admins can switch between the LIVE and TEST database configs directly from the top status area.
Added per-user persistence for the selected database mode so Press Layouts starts with the last selected LIVE or TEST config on the next launch.
Removed the startup Live/Test database selection prompt and replaced it with silent loading of the persisted database mode, defaulting safely to LIVE when no saved selection exists.
Changed database switching to clear launcher caches and force the PostgreSQL backend to reconnect using the newly selected config before refreshing the launcher list.

versions.summary: Restores true printed top alignment for all starter-sheet formats on the rotated landscape print path.

items: Fixed shared starter-sheet top alignment so Standard, USAT, and NYT now align to the physical printed top edge again on the rotated landscape print path by anchoring the rotated-image X position instead of centering it.
Kept the shared starter-sheet print path centered on the physical printed left/right axis while maintaining the existing 3/8 inch requested margins and the non-cutting trimmed-content print flow.

versions.summary: Simplifies starter-sheet printing to true horizontal centering plus top alignment with 3/8 inch margins.

items: Changed shared starter-sheet printing so align_top now means centered horizontally with the rendered top edge aligned to the requested top margin, instead of the previous landscape-specific left-edge anchoring behavior.

Changed the shared starter-sheet print helper to use 3/8 inch margins on all four sides while restoring normal whitespace trimming so the starter-sheet content is centered horizontally and top-aligned from its actual rendered content bounds.

Removed the temporary starter-sheet direction labels, the quarter-inch render shift, and the targeted crop experiments so the shared starter-sheet print path is now a clean centered-horizontal plus top-aligned implementation for both Starter-button and macro prints.

versions.summary: Adjusts starter-sheet printed margins toward 3/8 inch by applying targeted shared crop trims before printing.

items: Changed the shared starter-sheet print helper to crop 3/8 inch from the left, 5/16 inch from the right, and 3/8 inch from the top of the fully rendered starter-sheet image before printing, while leaving the bottom unchanged because it was already close enough.
Kept starter-sheet whitespace trimming disabled in the shared print helper so the targeted manual crop and render-time right shift are preserved instead of being auto-trimmed away.

versions.summary: Stops trimming starter-sheet whitespace before printing so the shared render-time right shift can actually reach paper.

items: Fixed starter-sheet right-shift tests that appeared to change scaling instead of moving on paper by adding a trim_whitespace switch to the shared print helper and disabling whitespace trimming for starter-sheet prints.

Kept layout printing on the existing trimmed print path while starter-sheet printing now preserves the full rendered page canvas so shared render-time left/right movement is no longer cropped back out before printing.

versions.summary: Moves the entire starter-sheet render 1/4 inch right because printer-position adjustments were not moving anything on paper.

items: Changed the shared starter-sheet renderer to shift the fully rendered starter-sheet image 0.25 inch to the right inside the page canvas so every printed starter-sheet element moves together on paper.
Removed the ineffective shared starter-sheet print-position X adjustment after print testing showed it did not move the printed output at all.

Kept the temporary TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT (-1/4"), and RIGHT (+1/4") diagnostic labels in the shared starter-sheet renderer so the next printed test can confirm that the whole starter sheet, including the labels, actually moved right.

versions.summary: Moves starter-sheet output 1/4 inch right on the shared print path and updates the temporary side labels to show the test direction.

items: Changed the shared starter-sheet printer helper to move printed starter sheets 0.25 inch to the right by applying the offset on the print-position X axis now that printed edge verification confirmed the physical left and right directions match the rendered image.
Changed the temporary shared starter-sheet side labels to show LEFT (-1/4") and RIGHT (+1/4") while keeping the TOP and BOTTOM diagnostics visible for print-direction verification.

versions.summary: Adds temporary printed edge labels to starter sheets so the physical top, left, right, and bottom can be verified.

items: Added temporary TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT, and RIGHT diagnostic labels around the shared starter-sheet renderer so both Starter-button and macro starter-sheet prints show which rendered edge lands on each physical printed side.
Removed the temporary quarter-inch starter-sheet render shift while printed edge diagnostics are being used so the direction test shows the unshifted shared starter-sheet output.

versions.summary: Moves starter-sheet output right by a quarter inch through the shared rotated starter-sheet renderer.

items: Changed the shared starter-sheet renderer to shift rendered starter-sheet content 0.25 inch on the rotated print-right axis inside the page image so printed starter sheets move right even when printer scaling leaves no extra placement slack.
Removed the starter-sheet printer-helper position adjustment so both Starter-button and macro starter-sheet prints now rely on the same shared rendered quarter-inch right shift.

versions.summary: Moves starter-sheet output on the actual printed left axis for the rotated landscape print path.

items: Changed starter-sheet left-margin adjustment to move along the shared starter-sheet print path's actual printed left axis by applying the quarter-inch offset on Y instead of X for the rotated landscape output.
Removed the old starter-sheet render-time image shift so the shared starter-sheet print helper is now the only place that applies the quarter-inch printed left adjustment.

versions.summary: Removes temporary starter-sheet test markers and routes both macro and Starter-button printing through the same shared starter-sheet print path.

items: Removed the temporary starter-sheet test markers and removed the launcher (TEST) flags after print-path verification was completed.

Changed Starter-button printing in the layout window to use the same shared starter-sheet image renderer and starter-sheet printer helper used by macro starter-sheet printing so both outputs now match.
Changed the shared starter-sheet printer helper to accept an optional printer name so both macro and Starter-button printing can use the same starter-sheet print function.

versions.summary: Fixes the missed editor-local starter-sheet print path used by the layout window Starter button.

items: Fixed starter-sheet debugging and margin-shift work to also update the separate editor-local starter-sheet renderer and printer path inside the layout window, which is the path used by the Starter print button.
Added a temporary EDITOR TEST marker and the same 0.25 inch right shift to the editor-local starter-sheet render path so printed output can confirm the correct starter-sheet code path is being hit.

versions.summary: Adds a visible TEST flag to the main launcher title area so source-run builds are obvious at startup.

items: Added a red (TEST) flag beside the Layouts header and changed the launcher window title to Press Layouts (TEST) so it is easy to confirm when the newest Python source file is running.

versions.summary: Adds a temporary SHIFT TEST marker to starter sheets so printed output can confirm the source-code print path is being used.

items: Added a temporary visible SHIFT TEST box near the upper-left corner of generated starter sheets to confirm when starter sheets are being rendered from the currently edited Python source.

versions.summary: Moves starter-sheet content right by a quarter inch inside the rendered sheet so the printed left margin actually increases.

items: Fixed starter-sheet left-margin adjustments that did not visibly move on paper by shifting the rendered starter-sheet content 0.25 inch to the right inside the final sheet image before printing.

versions.summary: Applies starter-sheet left margin as an explicit print-position shift so it actually moves on paper.

items: Fixed starter-sheet left-margin adjustment by applying the extra 0.25 inch as an explicit print-position shift after scaling instead of only changing the requested margin box.

versions.summary: Increases the starter-sheet print left margin by an extra quarter inch.

items: Changed starter-sheet printing to add 0.25 inch more left margin while keeping the other default print margins the same.

versions.summary: Uses a custom always-on-top dialog for the single-instance warning instead of a standard message box.

items: Changed the single-instance warning to use a custom Press Layouts dialog that stays always on top until dismissed, instead of the default message box.

versions.summary: Hardens the single-instance launcher guard so duplicate starts now reliably refocus the existing window and show the one-instance warning.

items: Fixed main launcher single-instance enforcement by replacing the previous startup guard with a stronger Windows mutex plus activation listener approach.
Fixed duplicate Press Layouts launches so the already-running launcher or startup dialog is brought to the front and shows a one-instance warning instead of allowing another main launcher to open.

versions.summary: Limits Press Layouts to one launcher instance and brings the existing launcher to the front when another start is attempted.

items: Changed startup so only one Press Layouts main launcher instance can run at a time.
Changed second-launch attempts so the existing Press Layouts window is brought to the front and shows a message that only one main launcher instance can be run at a time.

versions.summary: Makes the update notification open above every window and stay always on top until dismissed.

items: Changed the newer-version update notification so it opens above all other windows and remains always on top until it is closed or Restart is chosen.

versions.summary: Removes the main launcher preview pane label/header entirely while keeping the preview resize handle intact.

items: Changed the main launcher preview pane to remove the Preview label/header entirely while keeping the resize sash and preview area behavior the same.

versions.summary: Tightens the main launcher preview title area by replacing the bulky label-frame header with a smaller compact header.

items: Changed the main launcher preview pane to use a compact Preview header instead of the larger default labelframe title area so more height is available for the preview image.

versions.summary: Removes more wasted vertical space around the main launcher button row so the preview gets more usable height.

items: Changed the main launcher upper pane padding so there is less blank space below the button row before the preview sash.
Changed the main launcher button row spacing so the buttons sit much closer to both the treeview and the preview sash.
Changed the main launcher preview frame padding slightly so a little more of the lower pane height goes to the preview area itself.

versions.summary: Tightens the launcher button-to-preview spacing and makes the database selector remember its window position.

items: Changed the main launcher button row to reduce the space below it so the preview pane gets a little more vertical room.
Changed the admin Live/Test database selector window so it now remembers its last window position like the other remembered windows.

versions.summary: Condenses the launcher status line, moves database connection status into DB Maintenance, and gives the main preview more room.

items: Changed the main launcher top row so the Live/Test database label, (ADMIN) flag, username, and version appear together on one line at the right side opposite the Layouts label.
Changed the main launcher filters so Search now sits on its own row, while Issue Date appears before Press and Format on the filter row.
Changed the main launcher action-button row padding to 10 pixels above and below so the preview area has a little more room.
Moved the pulsing database connection status bar out of the main launcher preview area and into the DB Maintenance window.

versions.summary: Shows the Live/Test database label only for admins and places it on the same line as the admin status flag.

items: Changed the main launcher top-right status so the Live/Test database label is shown only for admins.
Changed the admin status area so the Live/Test database label appears on the same line as the (ADMIN) label instead of on its own row.

versions.summary: First release of the shared launcher using compiled binaries.

items: Added the shared launcher executable with compiled binaries.

versions.summary: Update-detected restarts now relaunch Press Layouts through the shared launcher path.

items: Changed the newer-version update dialog so choosing Restart relaunches Press Layouts from L:\PressLayouts\launcher\press_layouts_launcher.exe when that launcher is available.
Changed restart requests triggered by shared restart flows to fall back to the existing launcher-managed restart exit code only when the shared launcher executable cannot be started.

versions.summary: Bumped version to 1.2.28 for a new release with the same changelog as 1.2.27.

items: Added a launcher status indicator that shows whether Press Layouts is currently connected using the Live or Test database selection.
Changed EXE distribution startup so changelog.json is read from L:\changelog.json and the live database config is read from L:\press_layouts_db.json.
Changed admin startup for MBradbury so launch now prompts for Live or Test database selection, with Test using L:\working\press_layouts_db.json.
Changed restart after update checks and restart after database restore to relaunch L:\press_layout.exe instead of the extracted temporary runtime or a Python script.
Removed runtime dependency install checks and prompts from the EXE build since packaged distributions already contain the required dependencies.

versions.summary: Adds a visible live/test database indicator in the launcher and aligns EXE distribution settings with shared L:\ files and relaunch behavior.

items: Added a launcher status indicator that shows whether Press Layouts is currently connected using the Live or Test database selection.
Changed EXE distribution startup so changelog.json is read from L:\changelog.json and the live database config is read from L:\press_layouts_db.json.
Changed admin startup for MBradbury so launch now prompts for Live or Test database selection, with Test using L:\working\press_layouts_db.json.
Changed restart after update checks and restart after database restore to relaunch L:\press_layout.exe instead of the extracted temporary runtime or a Python script.
Removed runtime dependency install checks and prompts from the EXE build since packaged distributions already contain the required dependencies.

versions.summary: Uses icon.ico as the window icon for the launcher and child dialogs when the file is present beside the script.

items: Changed the launcher and child window creation flow to apply icon.ico from the script folder as the application window icon whenever the file is available.

versions.summary: Ensures monthly macro confirmation dialogs open large enough on first run so controls are not cut off.

items: Fixed the USAT Monthly, GRE Homefinder Monthly, and shared Sunday-only monthly macro confirmation dialogs so they auto-expand to fit their full content on first run instead of opening too short and cutting off controls.

versions.summary: Adds four new Sunday-only comics monthly macros for AUG, GRE, RAL, and USAT CO.

items: Added AUG COMICS Monthly, GRE COMICS Monthly, RAL COMICS Monthly, and USAT CO COMICS Monthly launcher macros for JSaalsaa and MBradbury by cloning the GRE Homefinder monthly Sunday-only workflow and pointing each macro at its matching regular.

Changed the shared Sunday-only monthly macro flow so GRE Homefinder and the new comics macros all use the same confirmation summary, separate layout and starter-sheet print options, progress window, and end-of-run report structure.

versions.summary: Splits monthly macro printing options so layouts and starter sheets can be printed independently.

items: Changed the USAT Monthly and GRE Homefinder Monthly confirmation dialogs so Print generated output now uses separate checkboxes for layouts and starter sheets, allowing either option or both to be selected.

Changed the USAT Monthly and GRE Homefinder Monthly macro runs so layout printing and starter-sheet printing now follow the individual confirmation checkbox selections instead of a single combined print toggle.

versions.summary: Cloned layouts now keep the existing product name while clearing the issue date for the new copy.

items: Changed layout cloning from the main launcher so new cloned layouts keep the source layout's product name instead of clearing it, while still blanking the issue date for the new copy.

versions.summary: Adds a GRE Homefinder Monthly launcher macro for Sunday-only layout generation and printing.

items: Added a GRE Homefinder Monthly macro for JSaalsaa and MBradbury that clones the USAT monthly workflow using the regular GRE Homefinder source.
Configured the GRE Homefinder Monthly macro to generate layouts only for Sunday issue dates in the selected month and optionally print each layout with its starter sheet.

versions.summary: Fixes layout save template prompts so matching database templates are recognized.

items: Fixed layout save/save-as template prompting so matching templates stored in the PostgreSQL template collection are recognized instead of only checking legacy flat-file template JSON files.
Kept the imposition-name and structural template matching fallback so renamed templates still suppress the unnecessary save-template prompt.

versions.summary: Fixes starter-sheet font helper references introduced by the USAT monthly print additions.

items: Fixed the shared starter-sheet renderer helpers to call the existing _render_load_starter_font function so editor diagnostics no longer flag _load_starter_font as undefined.
Kept the USAT monthly print helpers aligned with the existing starter-sheet rendering code path so printing support continues to compile cleanly.

versions.summary: Fixes USAT monthly printing so selected generated layouts and starter sheets are actually sent to the default printer.

items: Fixed the USAT monthly macro so choosing the Print option now actually prints each generated layout and starter sheet during the run instead of only recording the setting in the confirmation dialog.
Fixed the USAT monthly report counts so printed layouts, printed starter sheets, and print failures now reflect the actual work performed by the macro.

versions.summary: Adds optional USAT monthly printing for generated layouts and starter sheets.

items: Added a Print option to the USAT monthly confirmation dialog so users can choose whether to print generated output before running the macro.
Added automatic USAT monthly printing that sends 5 copies of each generated layout and 1 copy of each generated starter sheet to the default printer when the Print option is selected.
Updated the USAT monthly completion report to show printed layouts, printed starter sheets, and any print failures alongside creation, overwrite, skip, and preview results.

versions.summary: Adds a progress window and report dialog to the USAT monthly macro.

items: Added a progress window to the USAT monthly macro that shows the current issue date, regular name, target filename, and overall item progress while layouts are being generated.
Added a report dialog at the end of the USAT monthly macro run that lists processed issue dates plus the layouts that were created, overwritten, skipped, and any preview failures.

versions.summary: Adds a USAT monthly confirmation summary and overwrite-or-skip handling for existing layouts.

items: Added a confirmation summary before the USAT monthly macro runs showing the selected month, weekday issue-date count, layout count, and how many target layouts already exist.
Added overwrite and skip options for existing target layouts in the USAT monthly macro run confirmation dialog.
Updated the USAT monthly macro completion flow so results are shown in a detailed report after generation instead of a simple count-only finish message.

versions.summary: Adds launcher macros with a USAT monthly generator for selected users.

items: Added a clickable username link in the top right corner of the main launcher for JSaalsaa and MBradbury that opens a Macros dialog with a Run button.
Added a USAT monthly macro with a month/year picker that generates USAT layouts for every weekday issue date in the chosen month from the matching regulars.
Configured the USAT monthly macro so Monday through Thursday issues use the USAT A&B and USAT C&D regulars, while Friday issues use the USAT A&D and USAT B&C regulars.

versions.summary: New Layout now remembers whether each user last used Standard mode or From Regular mode.

items: Changed the New Layout window to save and restore whether each user last used Standard mode or From Regular mode.
Stored the per-user New Layout mode preference in the same user-specific window state JSON used for geometry and other remembered view settings.

versions.summary: Saves and restores each user's treeview view state, including expansion, selection, scroll, sort, and column sizes.

items: Changed the main launcher, New Layout, Template Editor, and Regular Editor to save and restore each user's treeview expand/collapse state, selected row, scroll position, sort order, and column widths.
Stored the per-user treeview view state alongside the existing user-specific window size and position data without letting geometry saves overwrite the treeview settings.

versions.summary: Adds the current username to the top-right launcher status area.

items: Added a username label in the top right corner of the main launcher above the version label.

versions.summary: Fixes restore backup reading so transactional restore no longer depends on pathlib.Path being imported.

items: Fixed database restore to read the selected SQL backup file with standard file I/O instead of pathlib.Path so restore no longer fails with "name "Path" is not defined".
Added target database and schema details to restore logging to make future restore troubleshooting faster.

versions.summary: Fixes restore failures caused by mapped-drive backup paths in the transactional wrapper.

items: Changed database restore so the temporary transactional wrapper now embeds the selected backup SQL directly instead of referencing it with a psql include path.
Fixed restore failures that could occur when backups were stored on mapped drives such as L:\SQL Server\Backups.

versions.summary: Adds last-success DB timing, makes restore transactional, and reduces psycopg editor warnings.

items: Added the last successful database check time to the launcher status area.
Changed database restore to use a transactional psql wrapper so a restore failure does not leave the Press Layouts schema dropped or half-restored.
Updated restore and maintenance messaging to point to L:\SQL Server\PostgreSQL\bin for psql and pg_dump.
Switched PostgreSQL driver loading to importlib-based imports in Press Layouts and the import helper script to reduce unresolved psycopg warnings in editors such as VS Code / Pylance.

versions.summary: Moves the launcher DB status below the preview, adds pulsing status, and expands maintenance tool discovery.

items: Moved the main launcher database status bar below the preview area.
Updated the launcher database status indicator to pulse green when connected and pulse red when offline.
Expanded the offline database status text to include the last connection error message when one is available.
Updated PostgreSQL maintenance tool discovery to prefer binaries under L:\SQL Server\PostgreSQL\bin.

versions.summary: Adds a launcher database status bar and improves backup defaults.

items: Updated DB Maintenance backups to default to L:\SQL Server\Backups with a timestamped SQL filename.
Added a main launcher database status bar that shows the configured server and database name.
Added a green or red database status indicator that reflects whether Press Layouts can currently connect to the configured PostgreSQL server and database.

versions.summary: Removes the reclaim placeholder and expands DB Maintenance backup and restore support.

items: Removed the Compress / Reclaim placeholder action from DB Maintenance.
Updated PostgreSQL client tool discovery so backup and restore look in PATH and under L:\SQL Server for pg_dump and psql.
Implemented database restore so it now resets the Press Layouts schema, imports the selected SQL backup with psql, refreshes launcher caches, and offers to restart the application afterward.

versions.summary: Moves admin maintenance actions into a dedicated DB Maintenance dialog and removes launcher regen buttons.

items: Removed the Regen Preview button from the main launcher, Template Editor, and Regular Editor.
Removed the Cleanup button from the main launcher and replaced the admin-only maintenance area with a new DB Maintenance button.
Added a DB Maintenance dialog for admins that includes the existing cleanup workflow plus database health check, backup, restore guidance, optimization, and compress/reclaim-space guidance actions.

versions.summary: Adds user-approved dependency installation prompts for startup and restart.

items: Added startup dependency checks for required packages such as Pillow and a PostgreSQL driver.
Added an Install prompt that lets users approve one-click dependency installation before the application continues loading.
Added the same dependency check and install prompt to the changelog-based restart flow.
Updated startup and restart handling so the application stops cleanly when required dependencies are missing and the user declines installation.

versions.summary: Default first-column sorting now shows correctly on initial treeview load.

items: Set the main launcher, New Layout, Template Editor, and Regular Editor treeviews to default-sort by their first column on initial load.
Fixed the initial sort indicator display so the first column now shows its ascending indicator immediately instead of waiting for the first click.

versions.summary: Fixed first-column sorting across the main and editor treeviews.

items: Fixed first-column sorting in the main launcher treeview so clicking Product now sorts correctly.
Fixed first-column sorting in the New Layout window so Template Name and Product sort correctly in the template and regular pickers.
Fixed first-column sorting in the Template Editor and Regular Editor treeviews.
Updated first-column headings to show the same ascending and descending sort indicators used by the other sortable columns.

versions.summary: Migrates layouts, templates, regulars, and previews to PostgreSQL with multi-user edit awareness.

items: Added PostgreSQL-backed storage for layouts, templates, regulars, and preview images.
Added automatic database and schema bootstrap using the configured PostgreSQL connection settings.
Added multi-user record-open awareness that warns when another user already has a record open and keeps a heartbeat while the record is being edited.
Added a one-time import path to move existing flat-file layouts, templates, regulars, and previews into PostgreSQL.
Changed the application to load and save all layout data directly from PostgreSQL instead of the Layouts, Regular, and Templates flat-file folders.
Changed Save As behavior so users provide a database record name instead of browsing a flat-file folder.
Updated preview storage so preview images are stored and retrieved from PostgreSQL alongside each record.

versions.summary: Fixed New Layout templates so Last Changed By shows cached template attribution instead of Unknown.

items: Fixed the New Layout template picker so template rows now carry forward cached last_changed_by values instead of dropping them and displaying Unknown.
Fixed New Layout template search and sorting so the Last Changed By column participates correctly.

versions.summary: Added per-user last-changed tracking for layouts, regulars, and templates, and surfaced it in treeviews.

items: Added best-effort logged-in Windows username capture for layout, regular, and template saves.
Added a Last Changed By column to the main launcher, New Layout picker, Template Editor, and Regular Editor treeviews.
Tracked JSON saves in Layouts, Regular, and Templates now stamp last_changed_by and refresh saved_at when the file is written, including Touch ALL and preview-related metadata writes.

versions.summary: Added a Save as Regular action to the layout editor.

items: Added a Save as Regular button to the layout editor that saves the current layout as a regular using the regular suggested filename in the regulars directory.

versions.summary: Touch ALL and save/save-as now share the same NYT and CO-aware USAT starter-format rules.

items: Updated Touch ALL so layouts whose product name contains NYT are set to the NYT starter format, and layouts whose product name contains USAT without the standalone word CO are set to the USAT starter format; all other layouts keep their existing starter format.

Updated layout save/save-as prompting so the USAT starter suggestion only appears when the product name contains USAT and does not contain the standalone word CO, while NYT still suggests the NYT starter format.

versions.summary: Audited non-editor save paths and hardened starter format persistence across both editor and touch workflows.

items: Updated collect_layout_data so non-template saves persist starter_format directly whenever the live or headless context provides it, reducing reliance on follow-up file rewrites.
Updated headless layout contexts used by touch/cleanup workflows to carry starter_format, hardening future non-editor save paths against dropping that persisted layout field.

versions.summary: Touch ALL now preserves each layout's existing starter format instead of resetting it to Standard.

items: Updated touch/cleanup normalization so layout files keep their existing starter_format value when Touch ALL re-saves them, preventing layouts from being reset back to Standard.

versions.summary: Section renames in the layout editor now resolve unit assignments by displayed section names before canonical section parsing.

items: Made section renaming in the layout editor more reliable by resolving unit section assignments against the actual displayed section names first, preventing custom letter-based section names from being misread as canonical section ids and unintentionally clearing or misrouting unit assignments.

versions.summary: Previews and printed layouts now share the same render path.

items: Updated the layout editor so both preview images and printed layouts now use the same print-image renderer, with the preview continuing to show only the top 50 percent of that rendered image.

versions.summary: Printed layouts now use the same taller unit color-box height as previews.

items: Updated the print renderer used by the layout editor so the color boxes below each unit use the same taller height based on grid cell size that previews already use.

versions.summary: Color swatch boxes under each unit now render taller in previews and printed layouts.

items: In the preview and printed layout renderers, the color boxes below each unit now use a height based on the layout grid cell height so they appear vertically larger and closer to the same height as the unit grid boxes.

versions.summary: Fixed grouped launcher folder counts so template and regular treeviews load correctly again.

items: Resolved a group-count initialization error that could prevent the New Layout, Template Editor, and Regular Editor treeviews from loading templates and regulars after the bold counted folder update.

versions.summary: Grouped treeviews now show bold counted folders, and the New Layout template list stretches correctly again.

items: Restored the New Layout template treeview layout so it stretches with the window again by reapplying the missing frame row and column weights.
Updated grouped rows in the main launcher, New Layout window, Template Editor, and Regular Editor to display bold folder-style labels with item counts for each press, format, and issue-date group.

versions.summary: Grouped fields now act only as folders while sortable columns focus on production details.

items: Updated the Template Editor and the New Layout template picker so press and format remain grouping folders only, while the sortable template columns are now Sections, Pages, and Last Saved.
Updated the Regular Editor and the New Layout regular picker so press and format remain grouping folders only, while the sortable regular columns are now Pages, Color Pages, Plates, and Last Saved.

Updated the main launcher so issue dates remain grouping folders only and the tree column now shows Product names for child rows while Press, Format, Pages, Color Pages, Plates, and Last Saved remain sortable.

versions.summary: New Layout launcher now groups template and regular pickers by press and format.

items: Updated the New Layout window so both the template picker and regular layout picker group rows by press and then by format, with all groups expanded by default.

versions.summary: Launcher trees now group layouts by issue date and templates and regulars by press and format.

items: Updated the main launcher treeview to group layouts under issue-date folders with tomorrow expanded by default and the remaining dates collapsed by default.
Updated the Template Editor and Regular Editor treeviews to group items first by press and then by format, with all groups expanded by default.

versions.summary: Cleanup Touch ALL now reapplies current imposition logic and renames corrected templates.

items: Updated Cleanup Touch ALL so existing layouts, regulars, and templates are re-saved using the current imposition logic, and templates are renamed to the corrected filename when the new imposition rule changes their name.

versions.summary: Imposition and template naming now infer virtual top rows for operator-side dinkies.

items: Updated imposition, template filenames, and template names so operator-side dinky units sort using an inferred virtual top row between the surrounding former/web units instead of the bottom-row page numbers.

versions.summary: Printed layouts no longer show the imposition line in either print render path.

items: Removed the Imposition line from the actual printed layout output and the headless print renderer used for generated previews.

versions.summary: Regular save filenames now use press/publication/section-page naming and first saves no longer prompt for a filename.

items: Updated regular save and save-as filename suggestions to use P# Publication SectionPages naming, omitting empty sections and joining populated sections with hyphens.
Updated Save in template, layout, and regular editors so a first-time save writes directly to the suggested filename without opening a filename confirmation dialog.

versions.summary: Save and Touch ALL now validate layouts, templates, and regulars with regular-mode issue date disabled.

items: Added save and Touch ALL validation for required issue date rules, required publication name rules, numeric-only grid cells, and section assignments based on whether the file is a layout, regular, or template.
Updated regular mode in the layout editor so the Issue Date field is disabled like template mode while still allowing blank issue dates for regular saves.
Updated Touch ALL so each layout, template, and regular file is validated before it is saved, while leaving starter format verification behavior unchanged for manual save and save-as.

versions.summary: Press unit grid fields now accept numbers only.

items: Updated all press unit grid cells so users can only type or paste numeric values, preventing letters and symbols from being entered.

versions.summary: Uppercase publication entry with starter format prompts for USAT and NYT saves.

items: Added a save and save-as prompt that offers to switch Starter to USAT when the publication name contains USAT and the current starter format is different.
Added a save and save-as prompt that offers to switch Starter to NYT when the publication name contains NYT and the current starter format is different.
Updated the publication name field in regular and layout editors to automatically convert text to all caps while typing and when loading saved layouts.
Updated starter sheet publication rendering, saved layout publication values, and layout filename suggestions to use uppercase publication names.

versions.summary: Starter sheet color change boxes expanded to every format with cleaner aligned sizing and placement.

items: Added Color Addition and Color Drop boxes to the Standard and USAT starter sheet formats.
Updated all three starter sheet formats so Color Addition and Color Drop match the size of Last Image and Last Plate and sit directly underneath them.
Adjusted the remaining USAT and NYT starter sheet boxes to align cleanly with the same left and right column widths used by the main starter sheet rows.

versions.summary: Automatic update checks with restart prompt for newer program versions.

items: Added an automatic changelog version check that runs every 10 minutes while the main launcher is open.
Added an update dialog that tells users when they are not running the latest version and reminds them to save their work before restarting.
Added Restart and Cancel buttons to the update dialog.
Updated the launcher restart flow so choosing Restart closes the current instance and relaunches the program using the latest Python files on disk.

versions.summary: Starter sheet refinements for publication header, total pages, and format-specific field adjustments

items: Added an auto-populated Total Pages field to the Standard, USAT, and NYT starter sheet formats.
Replaced the starter sheet title label on all three starter sheet formats with a full-width Publication box.
Updated the USAT starter sheet so the First Image box matches the Last Image box size and is positioned directly below it on the left side.
Removed the NYT CLOSE DETAILS header line from the NYT starter sheet format.

versions.summary: All new starter sheets for all 3 formats

items: Added all new starter sheet layouts for the Standard, USAT, and NYT formats.

versions.summary: Headless preview regeneration for launcher and cleanup tools

items: Added a direct preview regeneration helper that rebuilds .preview.png files from saved JSON data without opening a layout editor window.
Updated the main launcher, template editor, regular editor, and Cleanup Layouts dialog to use headless preview regeneration for manual and bulk preview rebuilds.
Removed obsolete temporary-window preview regeneration code paths from the UI build where they were no longer needed.
Fixed preview regeneration actions that still flashed a layout editor window when rebuilding individual previews or regenerating all previews from the cleanup tool.

versions.summary: Adjusted font for printed layout to improve readability

items: Adjusted the font used in the printed layout to improve readability and ensure that all text is clear and legible when printed.

versions.summary: Fix layout issues in printed output

items: Resolved an issue where the layout of the printed output was not displaying correctly.

versions.summary: Add legend and color page list to printed layout

items: Added a legend to the printed layout to provide context for the page list.
Added a color page list to the printed layout.
Updated the layout of the printed output to accommodate the new legend and color page list.
Improved the styling of the printed layout for better readability.

versions.summary: Press and format conversions in layout editor

items: Press and format conversions in layout editor.
Fixed a bug where change tracking in the layout editor was not working correctly causing the save changes dialog to trigger even when no changes were made.

versions.summary: Fixed page count calculation in layout editor

items: Corrected the page count calculation in the layout editor.

versions.summary: Changes New Layout window to a treeview with filters

items: The New Layout window now uses a treeview to display available layouts, allowing for better organization and easier navigation.
Added filter options to the New Layout window, enabling users to quickly find specific templates and layouts.
Layout editor now calculates the page counts for the sections automatically.

versions.summary: Adds launcher version loading from changelog.json and a clickable changelog history view.

items: The main launcher now pulls its version number from changelog.json.
Clicking the version label opens the changelog history dialog.
Updated changelog storage to keep multiple versions in one file.
Added a compact changelog view with collapsible version sections.

versions.summary: Initial release of the Press Layout launcher.

items: Initial consolidated launcher UI for Press Layouts.
Layout browsing, filtering, and preview support.

Layout Planning wizard for building planned sections, splitting sections into legal signatures, selecting color pages, assigning sections to press runs, matching templates, and generating and opening finished layouts.
Double-truck support across the layout editor, previews, and printed layouts, including planning validation and parsing of center-spread double trucks from email manifests.
Manifest drag-and-drop from Outlook, .msg and .eml files, and PDFs onto the Plan button or planning wizard.
Go to Tomorrow button on the main launcher.
Admin-only product-name translation table for planning-manifest PDFs.
DB Maintenance refresh of stale record-open locks.
Outlook message and .msg manifest parsing now reads the full message body, including continuation lines, so long split and main manifests parse completely.
Manifest PDF parsing now handles three or more section columns and matches color pages by position.
Preview panels now auto-refresh when a layout is saved by any user, including database-stored layouts.
Template Editor Save As now creates a proper renamed copy while leaving the original template intact.
Faster startup and browsing with cached translation tables and window state, a PostgreSQL connection pool, and reduced polling.
Plan button moved into the New Layout window with auto-generated press run names.
Templates saved from layouts now normalize to contiguous page numbers starting at 1.
Drag-and-drop rebuilt on tkinterdnd2 for reliable cross-application support.
